title: get_setup_grant
description: What this device may give when it sets up a device of platform (default ios) or, with purpose invite, invites a guest (only kind guest). For “type first” (choose what to set up before scanning) and the invitation screen. Answer: setup_grant, or onboard_error {not_permitted} without the rule setup_devices.

platform.description: Platform of the device to set up; default ios.

purpose.description: invite = grant of a guest invitation (kinds: guest only); default onboard.
